ValidationRule.description: Timecard Actual hours are greater than estimated hours on the PTA.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( NOT(ISPICKVAL( Project__r.Project_Sub_Types__c , "IBS - Ongoing Work")), NOT(ISPICKVAL( Project__r.pse__Project_Type__c , "Internal")), Timecard_Hours__c > pse__Estimated_Hours__c )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: OVER BUDGET!! Timecard Hours are greater than the Estimated Hours you have been allocated for this Task.
